ALTITUDE AND DEPTH: 1920–1990
================================

  HIGH ALTITUDE:
  1922 ─── First Everest expedition. George Mallory: "Because it's there."
  1924 ─── MALLORY+IRVINE: disappeared near summit. Did they reach it?
  1950 ─── HERZOG+LACHENAL: Annapurna (8,091m). First 8,000m summit.
  1953 ─── HILLARY+TENZING: Everest (8,848m) summit. May 29.
  1978 ─── MESSNER+HABELER: Everest without supplemental oxygen.
  1980 ─── MESSNER: Everest solo, without oxygen.
  1986 ─── MESSNER: Completes all 14 eight-thousanders.

  DEEP SEA:
  1930 ─── BEEBE+BARTON: Bathysphere. 435m depth.
  1948 ─── PICCARD (Auguste): Bathyscaphe concept.
  1950s ─── COUSTEAU: Aqua-Lung. Scuba diving. Calypso expeditions.
  1960 ─── PICCARD (Jacques)+WALSH: Mariana Trench. 10,916m.
  1977 ─── HYDROTHERMAL VENTS discovered (Alvin submersible, Galapagos).
  1985 ─── BALLARD: Titanic discovered (deep-sea ROV).
  2012 ─── CAMERON: Solo descent to Challenger Deep in Deepsea Challenger.
